_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. The three-tier goal ladder (spec section 10) and the authored beats. tiers: limits in PLAYER seconds the report checks (now_max_s = the longest a 'now' goal may take; district_gap_max_s = the longest wait between two district-tier goals). The 'now' goal is generated from state: the source step if one is open, else this hex, else the next hex stage, else the next purchase. District-tier goals are the district's next stage, its source steps and each mastery level. The planet goal is districts restored out of the total. beats: authored one-off steps (the tutorial table in PLAN section 8 and the progression map in section 7). event = the simulator event that completes it; mechanic = it counts as a new mechanic for the cadence rule; spike = the design intends a power spike here; player_min = the target minute from PLAN section 7 (player time), where it gives one. Event names: first_payout, first_upgrade, hexes_<n>, own:<id> (an unlock, research node or grant is owned), first_research, first_robot, robot:<type>, first_mastery, first_plant, source_step:<district>:<n>, source_shut:<district>, enter:<district>, stage:<district>:<n>, first_module, first_surge, first_piece, set_complete, launch_ready.
